name: palette-guard
title: Palette Guard
description: Stops chart series becoming indistinguishable for colour-blind readers by simulating protan, deutan and tritan vision (Machado 2009), flagging every pair under a CIEDE2000 threshold that passes Okabe–Ito, and offering the smallest lightness-only fix that clears all clashes, or patterns and direct labels when no colour change can.

meta.stops: Chart colours look identical to colour-blind readers
